scope.purpose: Define operational, maintenance, and facility-management information required for maintainable assets through commissioning and handover.

requirements.statement: Asset Information Requirements shall apply to all maintainable equipment and architectural components designated in the asset breakdown structure.
Asset parameters specified in the AIR shall be populated prior to Handover milestone sign-off.
Model authors shall not substitute proprietary classification systems for the mandated asset classification standard.
Operating and maintenance manuals may be referenced via validated external document URLs in parameter fields.

provenance.migration_note: Feeds S8 asset/lifecycle schema requirements. FM and Client/Owner role references remain unresolved.
